title: LeafSkill: Efficient Leaf-Level Action Grounding for Recursive LLM Agents
title_zh: LeafSkill：面向递归大语言模型智能体的高效叶级动作落地

paragraphs.en: Recursive large language model (LLM) agents often invoke a large host model after decomposition has reduced the problem to grounding a leaf task into one executable action. Our traces show that this last-mile grounding consumes 22.9–44.5% of host-model tokens. We introduce LeafSkill, an external action-grounding layer that reuses local task–action experience without taking over recursive planning. LeafSkill separates recall from execution: semantic retrieval proposes task–action templates, deterministic binding instantiates currently admissible actions, and a lightweight controller selects a candidate or abstains. The controller cannot generate free-form commands, and abstention returns control to the host. With the same ReCAP planner and Qwen3.5-27B host, LeafSkill reduces host tokens on jointly solved tasks by 23.1% on Robotouille and 41.3% on ALFWorld, each averaged over all nine cross-run pairings of three independent repeats; an independent Robotouille set yields a 14.4% reduction. Mean observed success is numerically higher for LeafSkill in both environments. A disjoint growth study expands the library from 446 to 588 skills without selector retraining or test trajectories; on tasks solved by all systems, host-token savings deepen from 18.3% to 25.6%. Ablations show that retrieval supplies paraphrase coverage, binding enforces executability, and learned selection controls when reuse is appropriate. Leaf-level action grounding therefore reduces expensive host inference while preserving recursive planning and recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 递归式大语言模型（LLM）智能体通常在分解已将问题简化为把叶子任务落地为单个可执行动作之后，仍然调用庞大的宿主模型。 我们的轨迹显示，这种“最后一公里”落地消耗了宿主模型 22.9–44.5% 的词元。 我们提出 LeafSkill，一个外部动作落地层，它在不接管递归规划的前提下复用本地“任务–动作”经验。 LeafSkill 将召回与执行分离：语义检索提出“任务–动作”模板，确定性绑定实例化当前可采纳的动作，一个轻量级控制器选择候选动作或弃权。 该控制器无法生成自由格式的命令，弃权时控制权交还给宿主。 在使用相同的 ReCAP 规划器和 Qwen3.5-27B 宿主的情况下，LeafSkill 在联合解决的任务上将宿主词元在 Robotouille 上降低 23.1%，在 ALFWorld 上降低 41.3%，二者均为三次独立重复实验全部九种跨运行配对的平均值；在独立的 Robotouille 任务集上取得 14.4% 的降低。 在两个环境中，LeafSkill 的平均观测成功率在数值上均更高。 一项不相交增长研究将技能库从 446 扩展到 588 个技能，且无需重新训练选择器或测试轨迹；在所有系统都能解决的任务上，宿主词元节省从 18.3% 提升到 25.6%。 消融实验表明，检索提供了改写覆盖，绑定确保了可执行性，而习得的选择机制则控制何时适合复用。 因此，叶子级动作落地在保留递归规划与恢复能力的同时，减少了昂贵的宿主模型推理。

paragraphs.en: Recursive LLM agents tackle long-horizon tasks by decomposing goals into progressively smaller task nodes ( Yao et al. 2023b ; Yao et al. 2023a ; Hu et al. 2025 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ) . Yet decomposition does not eliminate expensive host-model inference. Even after a leaf task has become explicit, the agent may still invoke the same large model merely to translate that task into one action accepted by the current environment. For example, once the planner has produced “pick up onion1 from board1,” the remaining decision is no longer how to solve the overall goal, but how to ground this local instruction into an executable command.
paragraphs.zh: 递归式 LLM 智能体通过将目标逐步分解为更小的任务节点来应对长程任务（Yao et al. 2023b；Yao et al. 2023a；Hu et al. 2025；Zhang et al. 2025）。 然而任务分解并不能消除昂贵的主模型推理开销。 即使某个叶任务已经明确，智能体仍可能调用同一个大模型，仅仅是为了把该任务转化为当前环境所接受的一个动作。 例如，当规划器已经生成「从 board1 上拿起 onion1」之后，剩下的决策已不再是如何解决总体目标，而是如何将这条局部指令落地为一条可执行的命令。

paragraphs.en: We call this operation leaf-level action grounding : mapping an already specified task node to one currently admissible environment action, without altering decomposition, parent plans, or completion state. Although local, this operation recurs throughout a trajectory. A conservative audit of the source corpora used for library construction shows that strict leaf grounding consumes 22.9% and 23.7% of host-model tokens in two Robotouille splits, and 44.5% in ALFWorld (Figure 1 ). Leaf grounding is therefore a narrow but substantial target for reducing host inference. We study this opportunity using ReCAP as the recursive host, while leaving its planning, recovery, and completion mechanisms unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这一操作称为叶级动作落地（leaf-level action grounding）：将一个已指定的任务节点映射为当前可接纳的环境动作，且不改变分解结构、父计划或完成状态。 尽管是局部操作，它却在整条轨迹中反复出现。 对用于构建动作库的源语料库的保守审计显示，严格的叶级落地在两个 Robotouille 划分中分别消耗宿主模型 token 的 22.9% 和 23.7%，在 ALFWorld 中则消耗 44.5%（图 1）。 因此，叶级落地是减少宿主推理的一个范围虽窄但收益可观的目标。 我们以 ReCAP 作为递归宿主来研究这一机会，同时保持其规划、恢复与完成机制不变。

paragraphs.en: Reusing these decisions is not equivalent to exact-string caching. Semantically equivalent tasks may be expressed by different phrases, while similar phrases may encode different intents. Retrieved arguments may be absent from the current state, and the same task may ground to different actions under different observations. Effective reuse must therefore solve four distinct problems: semantic recall, state-dependent instantiation, candidate disambiguation, and safe abstention.
paragraphs.zh: 复用这些决策并不等同于精确字符串缓存。 语义等价的任务可能由不同的短语表达，而相似的短语可能编码不同的意图。 检索到的参数可能在当前状态中不存在，并且同一任务在不同观测下可能落地为不同的动作。 因此，有效的复用必须解决四个不同的问题：语义召回、状态相关的实例化、候选消歧以及安全弃权。

paragraphs.en: We introduce LeafSkill, an external action-grounding layer for recursive LLM agents. Its frozen library stores canonical-task/action-template pairs, each of which we call a skill ; multiple skills may share one canonical task key. Given a leaf task, semantic retrieval recalls related templates, deterministic binding instantiates them with entities from the current state and removes inadmissible actions, and a lightweight controller selects among the remaining request-local candidates or abstains. The controller cannot generate free-form commands, and abstention returns control to the host without changing agent state. LeafSkill thus delegates only the final choice within a finite, state-bound action set, while recursive planning, recovery, and goal completion remain entirely host-owned. This boundary distinguishes LeafSkill from systems that return retrieved text for host reinterpretation or route an entire prompt to another model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 LeafSkill，一个面向递归式大语言模型智能体的外部动作锚定层。 其冻结的技能库存储规范任务/动作模板对，我们将每一对称为一个技能；多个技能可以共享同一个规范任务键。 给定一个叶任务，语义检索召回相关模板，确定性绑定用当前状态中的实体实例化这些模板并移除不可采纳的动作，然后一个轻量级控制器在剩余的请求本地候选中做出选择，或选择弃权。 控制器无法生成自由格式的命令，弃权会将控制权交还给宿主，而不改变智能体状态。 因此，LeafSkill 只在一个有限的、状态绑定的动作集合内委托最终选择，而递归规划、恢复和目标完成则完全由宿主负责。 这一边界将 LeafSkill 与那些返回检索文本供宿主重新解释、或将整个提示词路由给另一个模型的系统区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Constrained grounding architecture. We develop a retrieve–bind–select layer that converts reusable task–action experience into state-bound admissible candidates, while preserving host-owned planning and recovery through explicit abstention.
paragraphs.zh: 受约束的落地架构。 我们开发了一个检索–绑定–选择层，将可复用的任务–动作经验转换为状态绑定的可采纳候选，同时通过显式弃权保留宿主自身的规划与恢复能力。

paragraphs.en: Cross-environment efficiency evidence. Across Robotouille and ALFWorld, we demonstrate substantial host-token reductions on jointly solved tasks, identify the complementary roles of retrieval, binding, and selection, and show that post-training library growth can further increase savings without selector retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 跨环境效率证据。 在 Robotouille 和 ALFWorld 两个环境中，我们在联合解决的任务上展示了显著的主机 token 节省，识别了检索、绑定与选择各自所起的互补作用，并表明无需重新训练选择器，训练后增长的知识库即可进一步扩大节省幅度。

paragraphs.en: ReAct interleaves reasoning with interaction ( Yao et al. 2023b ) , while Tree of Thoughts searches over intermediate reasoning states ( Yao et al. 2023a ) . HiAgent manages long-horizon context through hierarchical working memory ( Hu et al. 2025 ) , and ReCAP represents goals, subtasks, and feedback in a recursive task tree ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) . These approaches primarily improve planning, context management, and recovery. LeafSkill is complementary: it operates only after an environment adapter exposes an eligible leaf task, without taking over decomposition or tree-state control. We instantiate this boundary with ReCAP as the recursive host.
paragraphs.zh: ReAct 将推理与交互交替进行（Yao et al. 2023b），而 Tree of Thoughts 在中间推理状态上进行搜索（Yao et al. 2023a）。 HiAgent 通过分层工作记忆管理长程上下文（Hu et al. 2025），ReCAP 则以递归任务树表示目标、子任务与反馈（Zhang et al. 2025）。 这些方法主要改进规划、上下文管理与恢复能力。 LeafSkill 是互补的：它仅在环境适配器暴露出符合条件的叶子任务之后才介入，不接管分解或树状态控制。 我们以 ReCAP 作为递归宿主来实例化这一边界。

paragraphs.en: Agents reuse prior experience as verbal feedback or distilled lessons ( Shinn et al. 2023 ; Zhao et al. 2024 ) , executable programs or workflows ( Wang et al. 2024 ; Wang et al. 2025 ) , and retrieved demonstrations ( Kim et al. 2024 ) . RAG externalizes evidence from parametric generation ( Lewis et al. 2020 ) . Agent-oriented work includes ExpRAG, which retrieves trajectories into an action-generating context ( Ferraz et al. 2026 ) , and SkillRet, which benchmarks skill retrieval ( Cho et al. 2026 ) . Recent systems further structure experience as dependency-aware skill documents or executable multi-step graphs: Graph of Skills retrieves skill bundles and graph neighbors ( Liu et al. 2026 ) , whereas GraSP compiles typed skill DAGs with node-level execution and repair ( Xia et al. 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体将先前经验复用为言语反馈或提炼的经验教训（Shinn 等，2023；Zhao 等，2024）、可执行的程序或工作流（Wang 等，2024；Wang 等，2025），以及检索到的示例（Kim 等，2024）。 检索增强生成（RAG）将证据外化于参数化生成之外（Lewis 等，2020）。 面向智能体的工作包括 ExpRAG，它将轨迹检索到动作生成上下文中（Ferraz 等，2026），以及 SkillRet，它对技能检索进行基准测试（Cho 等，2026）。 近期系统进一步将经验组织为依赖感知的技能文档或可执行的多步图：Graph of Skills 检索技能包与图邻居（Liu 等，2026），而 GraSP 则编译带节点级执行与修复的类型化技能 DAG（Xia 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: LeafSkill differs in both reuse granularity and delegated authority (Table 1 ). It retrieves task–action templates, binds them to the current state, and permits the local controller to choose only among the resulting admissible actions or abstain. Candidate identities are request-local rather than members of a fixed global output vocabulary, so compatible skills can be added without changing the selector’s output space.
paragraphs.zh: LeafSkill 在复用粒度和委派权限两方面均有所不同（表 1）。 它检索“任务–动作”模板，将其绑定到当前状态，并允许本地控制器仅在由此得出的可采纳动作中进行选择，或选择弃权。 候选身份是请求局部的，而非固定全局输出词表中的成员，因此可以在不改变选择器输出空间的情况下添加兼容的技能。

paragraphs.en: Affordance-aware methods combine language-model proposals with external feasibility signals ( Ahn et al. 2022 ) . SCLPlan uses PDDL-defined symbolic oversight to constrain goal and plan construction ( Byrd et al. 2025 ) , while CRANE constrains language-model generation through grammar-constrained decoding ( Banerjee et al. 2025 ) . LeafSkill targets a narrower boundary: retrieval proposes reusable templates, deterministic binding converts them into currently admissible actions, and the learned controller selects only within that finite set or abstains. It therefore constrains one leaf-level action without modifying the host planner or its decoding process.
paragraphs.zh: 具可供性感知的方法将语言模型的提议与外部可行性信号相结合（Ahn 等 2022）。 SCLPlan 使用 PDDL 定义的符号监督来约束目标与规划的构建（Byrd 等 2025），而 CRANE 则通过语法受限解码来约束语言模型的生成（Banerjee 等 2025）。 LeafSkill 针对的是一个更窄的边界：检索提出可复用的模板，确定性绑定将其转换为当前可准许的动作，而学习到的控制器仅在该有限集合内进行选择或弃权。 因此，它只约束一个叶子层级的动作，而不修改宿主规划器或其解码过程。

paragraphs.en: LeafSkill has an offline construction stage and an online grounding stage. Offline, host trajectories are converted into canonical task–action templates and selector supervision. Online, LeafSkill is invoked only at adapter-eligible leaf tasks: it retrieves related templates, binds them to the current admissible action set, and either selects one action or abstains. Figure 2 summarizes both stages.
paragraphs.zh: LeafSkill 包含离线构建阶段和在线落地阶段。 在离线阶段，主机轨迹被转换为规范的任务–动作模板和选择器监督信号。 在在线阶段，LeafSkill 仅在符合适配条件的叶任务上被调用：它检索相关模板，将其绑定到当前可用的动作集合，然后要么选择一个动作，要么选择放弃。 图 2 总结了这两个阶段。

paragraphs.en: Canonicalization lowercases text, joins spaced object identifiers (e.g., fridge 1 → \rightarrow fridge1 ), tokenizes alphanumeric fields, and replaces instance suffixes with typed placeholders ( onion1 → \rightarrow onion# ). It normalizes entity indices but leaves paraphrase matching to retrieval. For each retrieved skill, the binder compares its canonical action with canonicalized strings in 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t} and requires every concrete object identifier mentioned by τ t \tau_{t} to occur in the action. It therefore enumerates current interface strings rather than asking a model to synthesize slot values.
paragraphs.zh: 规范化会将文本转为小写、合并带空格的对象标识符（例如 fridge 1 → \rightarrow fridge1）、对字母数字字段进行分词，并将实例后缀替换为带类型的占位符（例如 onion1 → \rightarrow onion#）。 它对实体索引进行归一化，但将释义匹配留给检索来完成。 对于每个检索到的技能，绑定器会将其规范化的动作与 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t} 中的规范化字符串进行比较，并要求 τ t \tau_{t} 提到的每个具体对象标识符都出现在该动作中。 因此，它会枚举当前的接口字符串，而不是让模型去合成槽位值。

sents.en: RQ3: Can a frozen selector exploit compatible skills added after training?

paragraphs.en: Robotouille contains synchronous cooking tasks and asynchronous tasks with waiting and parallel dependencies ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al. 2025 ) . ALFWorld provides household tasks with standard valid_seen and valid_unseen splits ( Shridhar et al. 2021 ) . Table 4 separates construction, analysis, and final evaluation data. Robotouille repeats over Group B estimate rollout variability on the same 200 tasks and are not pooled as 600 independent instances. In the growth study only, B-group ReCAP traces are added after selector training; Group C remains evaluation only.
paragraphs.zh: Robotouille 包含同步烹饪任务以及带有等待和并行依赖关系的异步任务（Gonzalez-Pumariega et al. 2025）。 ALFWorld 提供带有标准 valid_seen 和 valid_unseen 划分的家庭任务（Shridhar et al. 2021）。 表 4 区分了构建、分析和最终评估数据。 Robotouille 在相同的 200 个任务上重复 Group B 以估计轨迹的变异性，而不是合并为 600 个独立实例。 仅在增长研究中，Group B 的 ReCAP 轨迹是在选择器训练之后加入的；Group C 仅用于评估。

paragraphs.en: Every system retains the ReCAP recursive planner and Qwen3.5-27B host ( Qwen Team 2026 ) . We select ReCAP as the host because its published Robotouille pass@1 exceeds CoT, ReAct, and ADaPT under the original GPT-4o protocol ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) ; all comparisons here use our shared Qwen3.5-27B setup. Unless stated otherwise, Robotouille uses the Group-A library and Robotouille-trained selector, while ALFWorld uses the same 228-skill library with Robotouille initialization followed by valid_seen adaptation. The controller analysis below separates this default from bare, transfer-only, and target-only routes.
paragraphs.zh: 每个系统都保留 ReCAP 递归规划器和 Qwen3.5-27B 宿主（Qwen Team 2026）。 我们选择 ReCAP 作为宿主，是因为其已发表的 Robotouille pass@1 在原始 GPT-4o 协议下超过了 CoT、ReAct 和 ADaPT（Zhang et al. 2025）；此处的所有比较均使用我们共享的 Qwen3.5-27B 设置。 除非另有说明，Robotouille 使用 Group-A 库和基于 Robotouille 训练的选择器，而 ALFWorld 使用相同的 228 技能库，先进行 Robotouille 初始化，再进行 valid_seen 适配。 下文的分析将这一默认设置与仅迁移、仅目标以及裸基线路径区分开。

paragraphs.en: Success is computed over every scheduled episode, with terminated episodes counted as failures. Success differences use two-sided exact McNemar tests on all task pairs. Host efficiency is computed on tasks solved by both systems in a run pairing because failed long-horizon trajectories have heterogeneous stopping behavior, so their token counts conflate grounding cost with failure timing. We report reductions in Qwen3.5-27B prompt-plus-completion tokens and calls, termed paired-success host cost ; reporting full-set success alongside this metric prevents apparent savings from arising mechanically from earlier or more frequent failures. When both systems have three repeats, the reported reduction is the arithmetic mean of the nine cross-run pairings; tasks are intersected and the cost ratio is computed separately within each cell before averaging. A single-run ablation is paired with all three ReCAP repeats and reported as the mean of those three reductions. Group-C cost intervals use task-level bootstrap 95% CIs.
paragraphs.zh: 成功率在所有已安排的回合（episode）上计算，其中已终止的回合计为失败。 成功率差异在所有任务对上使用双侧精确 McNemar 检验。 主机效率在同一运行配对中由两个系统共同解决的任务上计算，因为失败的长程轨迹具有异质的停止行为，其 token 数会将接地成本与失败时机混在一起。 我们报告 Qwen3.5-27B 的提示加补全 token 和调用次数的减少量，称为配对成功主机成本；在报告该指标的同时报告全集成功率，可以防止明显的节省机械地来自更早或更频繁的失败。 当两个系统都有三次重复时，报告的减少量是九个跨运行配对的算术平均值；任务取交集，并在每个单元格内分别计算成本比后再取平均。 单次运行消融与全部三次 ReCAP 重复配对，并报告为这三个减少量的平均值。 Group-C 成本区间使用任务级自助法（bootstrap）95% 置信区间。

paragraphs.en: End-to-end methods share task identifiers, model services, context limits, decoding settings, and termination rules. Retrieval uses k = 5 k=5 and similarity threshold γ = 0.70 \gamma=0.70 throughout, with no test-set hyperparameter search. ALFWorld uses ten round-robin shards and a 49-action limit; every run records all 134 unseen games. Controller tokens are reported separately because the 1.7B and 27B tokenizers differ. Only LoRA parameters of the 1.7B selector are updated; the host, planner, retriever, and binder remain frozen. Each main-system SFT stage uses one epoch of rank-16 LoRA, batch size 1, gradient accumulation 16, learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , and maximum length 1,536 on one A800 80GB GPU; the context-augmented input-scope diagnostic uses maximum length 1,792.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端方法共享任务标识符、模型服务、上下文限制、解码设置与终止规则。 全程使用 k = 5 k=5 与相似度阈值 γ = 0.70 \gamma=0.70 进行检索，且未在测试集上进行超参数搜索。 ALFWorld 使用十个轮转分片和 49 步动作上限；每次运行记录全部 134 个未见游戏。 控制器 token 单独报告，因为 1.7B 与 27B 的分词器不同。 仅更新 1.7B 选择器的 LoRA 参数；宿主、规划器、检索器与绑定器保持冻结。 每个主系统 SFT 阶段在单块 A800 80GB GPU 上使用 rank-16 LoRA、批次大小 1、梯度累积 16、学习率 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} 以及最大长度 1,536 训练一个 epoch；上下文增强的输入范围诊断使用最大长度 1,792。

paragraphs.en: Across all nine cross-run pairings of the three Group-B repeats, LeafSkill reduces host tokens by 23.09% on average (range 16.85–29.68%, n = 87 n=87 –93 per pairing) and host calls by 22.54% on average (Figure 4 ). On the independently seeded Group C, the frozen Group-A library reduces tokens by 14.4% (95% CI [ 3.0 , 24.5 ] [3.0,24.5] ) and calls by 14.1% (95% CI [ 3.6 , 23.3 ] [3.6,23.3] ; Table 5 ). Observed success is 6.0–9.0 points higher on B and 8.0 points higher on C (137/200 versus 121/200, p = .0259 p=.0259 ; Table 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在三次 B 组重复运行的全部九次跨运行配对中，LeafSkill 平均减少宿主 token 23.09%（范围 16.85–29.68%，每次配对 n = 87–93），平均减少宿主调用 22.54%（图 4）。 在独立设置种子的 C 组上，冻结的 A 组库减少 token 14.4%（95% CI [3.0, 24.5]），减少调用 14.1%（95% CI [3.6, 23.3]；表 5）。 观测成功率在 B 组上高出 6.0–9.0 个百分点，在 C 组上高出 8.0 个百分点（137/200 对 121/200，p = .0259；表 6）。

paragraphs.en: Lexical rewrites change only the action predicate (e.g., Place → \rightarrow Set ); syntactic rewrites also reorder the command. Coverage requires the bound set to retain the source action. Mixed-rank instances add up to four admissible but intent-inconsistent distractors and place the source action last. All-negative instances bypass object-coverage binding and contain only admissible but leaf-inconsistent candidates; the correct output is FALLBACK_RECAP ( ⊥ \bot ). This is an OOD stress test, not an online condition. The input-scope diagnostic compares two separately trained selectors constructed from the same 3,177 examples and canonical-task split. Both are evaluated on the same 193 mixed-rank cases. The context-augmented selector additionally receives the true recursion depth, root goal, parent task, ancestor chain, and remaining siblings. Table 9 reports all sample sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 词汇重写仅改变动作谓词（例如，Place → \rightarrow Set）；句法重写还会对命令进行重新排序。 覆盖要求被绑定的集合保留源动作。 混合层级实例最多添加四个可采纳但与意图不一致的干扰项，并将源动作放在最后。 全否定实例绕过对象覆盖绑定，仅包含可采纳但与叶节点不一致的候选；正确输出为 FALLBACK_RECAP（⊥ \bot）。 这是一个分布外（OOD）压力测试，而非在线条件。 输入范围诊断比较了由相同 3,177 个示例和规范任务划分构建的两个分别训练的选择器。 两者都在相同的 193 个混合层级案例上进行评估。 上下文增强的选择器还接收真实的递归深度、根目标、父任务、祖先链以及剩余的兄弟任务。 表 9 报告了所有样本规模。

paragraphs.en: Exact reuse of raw task–action pairs changes paired host tokens by only 0.20% on average. Semantic retrieval over the same raw pairs yields an 8.08% reduction, while state-bound templates with direct Top-1 execution raise the reduction to 13.08% (Table 8 ). Canonical-Exact with the SFT selector reaches 67.0% success and 29.60% mean token reduction on the original benchmark wording. Its coverage falls from 99.5% on original reference actions to 0% under both controlled rewrites; semantic Top-5 retains 96.0% lexical and 97.0% syntactic coverage (Table 9 ). Semantic retrieval therefore supplies the paraphrase coverage used by the default system.
paragraphs.zh: 直接复用原始任务–动作对平均仅使配对的主机令牌减少 0.20%。 对相同原始对进行语义检索可带来 8.08% 的降幅，而结合直接 Top-1 执行的状态绑定模板将降幅提升至 13.08%（表 8）。 Canonical-Exact 配合 SFT 选择器在原始基准表述上达到 67.0% 的成功率和 29.60% 的平均令牌缩减。 其覆盖率从原始参考动作上的 99.5% 降至两种受控改写下的 0%；语义 Top-5 则保留了 96.0% 的词法覆盖率和 97.0% 的句法覆盖率（表 9）。 因此，语义检索为默认系统提供了所需的改述覆盖能力。

paragraphs.en: On the 100 tasks solved by both BGE Top-1 and LeafSkill R2, Top-5 selection provides a further 14.9% host-token reduction. SFT raises mixed-rank accuracy from 81.9% to 93.3%. End to end, Base reaches 113/200 success and 27.01% mean token reduction; SFT averages 62.17% success and 23.09% reduction, and is 9.0 points more successful in the direct R2 comparison ( p = .0198 p=.0198 ). Thus, the selector calibrates when and which bound candidate to execute. In the all-negative OOD diagnostic, SFT returns FALLBACK_RECAP in only 7.5% of cases. Because binding is bypassed, this measures controller-only fallback rather than online abstention and motivates deterministic binding before selection. Adding true planner context yields 90.7% mixed-rank accuracy versus 93.3% with the local interface.
paragraphs.zh: 在 BGE Top-1 与 LeafSkill R2 均求解成功的 100 个任务上，Top-5 选择可进一步降低 14.9% 的主机令牌消耗。 SFT 将混合排名准确率从 81.9% 提升至 93.3%。 端到端来看，Base 达到 113/200 的成功率和 27.01% 的平均令牌缩减；SFT 平均成功率为 62.17%，令牌缩减为 23.09%，并且在直接 R2 对比中成功率高出 9.0 个百分点（ p = .0198 p=.0198 ）。 因此，选择器能够校准何时执行以及执行哪个边界候选。 在全负例 OOD 诊断中，SFT 仅在 7.5% 的案例中返回 FALLBACK_RECAP。 由于绑定被绕过，这衡量的是仅控制器的回退而非在线弃权，因此说明在选择之前需要确定性绑定。 加入真实的规划器上下文后，混合排名准确率为 90.7%，而使用本地接口时为 93.3%。

paragraphs.en: After selector training, adding Group-B traces expands the library from 413 keys/446 skills to 527/588 without using Group C or updating controller parameters. On the fixed set of 88 tasks solved by all three systems, the expanded library increases the host-token reduction over ReCAP from 18.35% to 25.64% and the call reduction from 17.70% to 24.22% (Table 10 ). Comparing the two libraries directly on their 105 common successes, A+B reduces host tokens by 11.41% (95% CI [ 2.29 , 19.49 ] [2.29,19.49] ) and calls by 10.36% relative to A. Group-C success is 131/200 with A+B and 137/200 with A ( p = .5118 p=.5118 ). In the controlled selector diagnostic, inserting 124 held-out compatible keys yields 97.3% adoption and 98.9% retention. Together, these results show that a frozen selector can use compatible additions at read time.
paragraphs.zh: 在选择器训练完成后，加入 Group-B 轨迹可在不使用 Group C 或不更新控制器参数的情况下，将库从 413 个键/446 个技能扩展到 527/588。 在三个系统均能解决的 88 个固定任务集合上，扩展后的库将相对 ReCAP 的宿主令牌减少率从 18.35% 提高到 25.64%，调用减少率从 17.70% 提高到 24.22%（表 10）。 直接在两者共同的 105 个成功任务上比较这两个库，相对 A，A+B 将宿主令牌减少了 11.41%（95% 置信区间 [2.29, 19.49]），调用减少了 10.36%。 使用 A+B 时 Group C 的成功率为 131/200，使用 A 时为 137/200（p = .5118）。 在受控的选择器诊断中，插入 124 个留出的兼容键可获得 97.3% 的采用率和 98.9% 的保留率。 综合来看，这些结果表明冻结的选择器能够在读取时使用兼容的新增内容。

paragraphs.en: LeafSkill replaces repeated 27B leaf-grounding calls with a finite local choice while leaving planning and recovery to the host. Retrieval supplies paraphrase coverage, binding enforces admissibility, and selection resolves candidates. Request-local identifiers also support compatible additions: expanding the library from 446 to 588 skills deepens fixed-set host-token savings from 18.3% to 25.6% without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: LeafSkill 将重复的 27B 叶子级落地调用替换为有限的本地选择，同时把规划与恢复留给主机智能体。 检索提供改写覆盖，绑定保证可采纳性，选择则在候选之间做出裁决。 请求级局部标识符还支持兼容性扩展：将技能库从 446 扩充到 588 个技能，无需重新训练即可把固定集合的主机令牌节省从 18.3% 提升到 25.6%。

paragraphs.en: LeafSkill assumes recurring parameterizable leaves, a discrete admissible-action interface, and an environment adapter. New action grammars require corresponding adapters and binders, while open-ended or continuous actions may need richer executable-action interfaces. The present evidence covers one planner, one host, two environments, and one selector family.
paragraphs.zh: LeafSkill 假设存在可复现的、可参数化的叶子节点、一个离散的可执行动作接口，以及一个环境适配器。 新的动作语法需要相应的适配器和绑定器，而开放式或连续动作可能需要更丰富的可执行动作接口。 目前的证据仅涵盖一个规划器、一个宿主、两个环境和一个选择器家族。

paragraphs.en: Overall, LeafSkill shows that recurring leaf grounding can be separated from recursive reasoning without replacing the host planner. Across Robotouille and ALFWorld, its retrieve–bind–select layer reduces Qwen3.5-27B host tokens by 14.4–41.3%, while compatible library growth increases savings without selector retraining. These results support state-bound action reuse as a practical complement to recursive LLM planning rather than a replacement for it.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，LeafSkill 表明，可复现的叶级接地可以与递归推理分离，而无需替换宿主规划器。 在 Robotouille 和 ALFWorld 上，其检索–绑定–选择层将 Qwen3.5-27B 宿主的 token 减少了 14.4–41.3%，同时兼容库的增长在不重新训练选择器的情况下进一步提升了节省。 这些结果支持将基于状态绑定的动作复用作为递归 LLM 规划的实用补充，而非其替代品。
